paris.why: Lets you travel across the whole map, though a few guards can still recognize you.
paris.howToGet: Subdue one of the two guards patrolling near the small northern building and hide the body in a container.

paris.why: Reaches the 2nd and 3rd floors after a search, but not the private quarters or attic.
paris.howToGet: Subdue a lone worker in a western 2nd-floor room or the northern piano room.

sapienza.why: Good universal mansion disguise, though many staff may recognize you.
Opens the lab, though staff will see through it.
sapienza.howToGet: Take it from a dead employee in the morgue.

marrakesh.why: Lets you move around all of level 0 in the consulate and the school.
marrakesh.howToGet: Enter the level 0 tunnel through the underground car park, stun the guard who shows up and hide him in the closet.

marrakesh.why: Lets you walk around the consulate freely.
marrakesh.howToGet: Wait for him to visit the shisha cafe bathroom, stun him at the sink and hide the body.

bangkok.why: Described as getting you into many places.
bangkok.howToGet: Take it from the man in room 202's bedroom, reached by climbing the gutter from room 102.

bangkok.why: Access to the back of the hotel and the first floor.
bangkok.howToGet: Knock out a groundskeeper in the garden, ideally behind the stone flowerbed.

colorado.why: Reaches the main building (except two restricted rooms) and all regular farm areas, with a lower chance of being recognized.
colorado.howToGet: Sabotage a server in the ground-floor server room, then take out the hacker who investigates.

colorado.why: Same broad farm and main-building access as the Hacker.
colorado.howToGet: Take the spare uniform in the house, or an enemy by the small garage east of the house.

hokkaido.why: Called one of the best disguises in Hokkaido because bodyguards can go almost anywhere.
hokkaido.howToGet: Separate two bodyguards near the south cable cart with a thrown object and eliminate one, or lure a patrolling bodyguard near the morgue stairs.

hokkaido.why: Access to patient apartments and the main building.
hokkaido.howToGet: Poison a meal in the kitchen or a bottle in the main building and attack the doctor in a toilet.

miami.why: Called the best overall; near-highest clearance, can carry weapons on the back without suspicion.
Moves freely around the Kronstadt building and many zones; often carries the magnetic entrance card.

santa-fortuna.why: The disguise for entering Rico's mansion.
santa-fortuna.howToGet: Find the guard near Rico's hippo at the back of the caves past the ancient ruins and take his outfit.

isle-of-sgail.why: Called the best disguise: full access to the castle top floor (conclave room, Penthouse, Library, Constant's Office).
isle-of-sgail.howToGet: Take it from the same balcony as the Castle Staff outfit by luring a guard with a thrown object.

isle-of-sgail.why: Gives access to the lower levels of the castle.

dubai.why: White uniform roams a large part of the map and enters staff-only locked rooms.
dubai.howToGet: Take a guard on the stairs above the opening-reception bar floor and hide him in a closet.

dubai.why: Can carry a gun across the map and reach the top floor.
dubai.howToGet: Turn off the cameras on the third floor, then attack the guard patrolling by the server room.

dartmoor.why: Easiest disguise for moving around and exploring, with fewer detection risks.
dartmoor.howToGet: Lure a guard from the west wall with a coin or poisoned bottle and take him out in the toilet.

berlin.why: Best in Berlin: the only disguise that opens the biker building and the keycard-locked level -2 rooms.
berlin.howToGet: Take the unused outfit from the small toilet in the biker building, or take down a motorcyclist in the level -2 corridor.

berlin.why: Free movement through most of the club.
berlin.howToGet: Lure a guard from the outpost west of the club with a thrown object.

chongqing.why: Move through the whole open area (streets, alleys, rooftops); most guards ignore you.
chongqing.howToGet: Crowbar the Arcade game room side door and take the outfit from the cardboard boxes.

chongqing.why: Moves through the underground ICA complex.
chongqing.howToGet: Take it from a level -3 guard by distracting him with a terminal and ambushing from the closet.

mendoza.why: Called the best in the mission; lets you move across most of the map.
mendoza.howToGet: Lure one with a coin into the garden beside the parking-lot trailer, or open the level 2 armory cabinet.

mendoza.why: Gets into winery areas guests cannot enter.
mendoza.howToGet: Take one in a secluded spot near the parking lot.
